Pasting Clone a GitHub repository selects that row. The preview shows protocol = ssh and destination = ~/work/poly. Enter opens Clone a GitHub repository… · arguments. Esc returns to that row. The form title, activity output, and confirmation dialog are absent. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario parity-task-sources --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; paste Clone a GitHub repository; Enter
cases.return_path: Esc returns to the finder on the clone row; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: parity-task-sources lists Clone a GitHub repository…. The form has an owner choice defaulting to alex-dev, a required repository text field, a protocol choice of ssh or https, and a destination that defaults to ~/work/poly. Ctrl+S on an empty repository keeps the form open and shows Fill the required fields first and Required. Activity output and the confirmation dialog stay absent. Typing args-repo and choosing https shows gh repo clone 'alex-dev/args-repo' '~/work/poly' --protocol https. The open form is captured at 120×40, then at 80×24, while that value is filled and still unsubmitted. The terminal returns to 120×40 only after the narrow shot. Cancel (Tab, Tab, Enter) closes the form. The finder shows protocol = ssh again and args-repo is gone, so the activity was not started. ArgSpec::text and ArgSpec::choice both set secret: false in src/bin/holla/domain/action.rs. No ArgSpec assignment sets secret: true, and this launch never reaches a secret script prompt, so the secret operation is NOT_APPLICABLE.
cases.action_sequence: Fill each implemented argument type, enter invalid input, correct it, and cancel after an edit.
cases.expected_results: The displayed command and directory match the form. The secret is masked.
